brand.name: ReflexDesk
brand.setup_subtitle: One quick setup. After this, ReflexDesk lives quietly in your system tray and appears only when you need it.

onboarding.step1_desc: ReflexDesk can auto-detect speech, but choosing your main language makes the first experience more predictable.
onboarding.step2_desc: Recommended. ReflexDesk stays hidden in the tray.
onboarding.step3_desc: We'll check your microphone and start the local speech engine.
onboarding.step4_desc: Voice test unlocks after the local engine is ready.
onboarding.step4_engine_ready: Local engine ready. Say a short phrase to prove microphone → speech → ReflexDesk works.
onboarding.step4_heard_retry: I heard “{heard}”. Try again and say: “Hello ReflexDesk”.
onboarding.preparing_nemotron: Preparing NVIDIA Nemotron locally. First setup may download the model…
onboarding.fix_issue_retry: Fix the issue above, then retry setup.
onboarding.done_benchmark: Local speech passed in about {ms} ms.

dashboard.ready_subline: Press the shortcut anywhere, or start listening here.
dashboard.listening_subline: Speak naturally. Press the shortcut again to stop.
dashboard.working_subline: Everything stays local unless online fallback is enabled.
dashboard.error_subline_default: The local engine did not start correctly.
dashboard.preparing_subline: Your local speech engine starts in the background.
dashboard.setup_required_subline: The local engine must be ready before voice control can start.
dashboard.attention_engine_not_ready: The local engine is not ready.

settings.voice_subtitle: How ReflexDesk listens and how it answers.
settings.application_subtitle: Interface language, startup and window behaviour.
settings.secondary_language_help: Optional. Enables automatic language detection for speech.
settings.spoken_feedback_help: Announce action results with an installed offline voice.
settings.spoken_feedback_unavailable: No offline voice is installed for spoken replies.
settings.start_at_login_help: Keep ReflexDesk ready without opening a window.
settings.overlay_help: Show the small voice-reactive particle indicator.
settings.shortcut_help: Press anywhere to start or stop listening.
settings.reset_confirm: Run first-time setup again? Your local model cache will be kept.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Local by default.
privacy.allow_online_ai_help: Off keeps everything on this computer. When on, microphone audio and text may be sent to the online provider you select below and may incur charges.
privacy.network_note: Local Nemotron speech stays offline and is always the default. Online audio is an opt-in you enable here.

provider.title: Online Provider
provider.subtitle: Credentials stored securely in OS vault — never in settings or logs.
provider.api_key_help: Stored in the OS vault. Required before online AI and voice can run.
provider.auth_invalid: Provider rejected API key (401/403). Please rotate your key.
provider.stt_engine_help: Nemotron and Moonshine run offline on this computer. OpenRouter sends microphone audio to the network.
provider.tts_engine_help: Offline voices stay on this computer. OpenRouter synthesizes replies in the cloud.
provider.openrouter_stt_model_help: Used only when OpenRouter is the speech engine.
provider.openrouter_tts_model_help: Used only when OpenRouter reads the replies.
provider.openrouter_tts_voice_help: Voice name supported by the selected model.
provider.network_notice: Remote audio opt-in: microphone audio and reply text are uploaded to the online provider you select, and only while online AI and voice is enabled. Charges may apply.
provider.billing_notice: Online voice is billed by the provider on your own account and may incur charges. The API key is stored in the OS vault and is never shown again.
provider.requires_online: Online audio stays disabled until “Allow online AI and voice” is turned on above.
provider.remote_speech_requires_key: Connect an OpenRouter API key to use cloud speech.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.subtitle: ReflexDesk can hand larger jobs to tools already installed.

skills.title: Skills & Automations
skills.subtitle: Deterministic multi-step workflows without unrestricted machine access.
skills.empty: No custom skills installed. Record a workflow or import a pack.
skills.recording_active: Recording active: Perform actions to compile a skill…
skills.recording_stopped: Recording stopped. Compiled draft skill ready for review.
skills.confirm_delete: Delete skill '{name}'? This cannot be undone.

footer.tray_hint: Closing this window keeps ReflexDesk running in the system tray.

errors.unknown_tool: Tool is unknown or not permitted by policy.
errors.auth_invalid: Authentication failed. Please check or rotate your credentials.
errors.mic_permission_denied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow microphone access in system settings.
errors.stt_unavailable: Local speech engine is not running or unavailable.
errors.model_download_failed: Failed to download required speech model. Please check network connection.
errors.policy_denied: Action was denied by policy gate.
